name: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner.  Someone to do a little traveling for him.  How about it?  Are you the friend for the job?

If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.
narrative.offerRewardText:
That's right. I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding. In fact, it'll take you far from Loch Modan.

Your perfect chance for adventure!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 14 to 15, 1,525 XP in all.

quests.name: Stormpike's Order
quests.objectiveText: Bring Stormpike's Request to Furen Longbeard in Stormwind.
